uncovered.reason: Only the explicitly listed initial fixture views are compared. Interactive states, other themes and widths, open portals, and every unlisted catalog family remain unaccepted; declared fixture state labels are not executed coverage.
Component catalog journeys do not cover real daemon flows or Electron application behavior. See migration-inventory.json for the full denominator.

Uncovered: accordion multiple/disabled loop edges, choice-group disabled/readonly/form serialization, slider scaled pointer coordinates, sheet top/bottom/stacked overlays/full-motion reversals, list focus recovery after deleting the active nested control. Existing fixture labels do not count as executed cases.
select-focus, text-entry-focus, modal-heading-spacing and settings-textarea registered previews are not yet in the checked visual manifest; no image parity acceptance is claimed for them.

Uncovered: question completion callback counts/latest snapshot, back/skip, attachment and shortcut ownership; composer native file acceptance, IME, queue drag/reorder; async picker pending/error/retry/stale results, grouped actions/rename; sidebar mobile/rail/nested focus; relative time, animated numbers, real avatar errors and widget virtual list; clipboard/file-input/settings/native pages. Only explicitly authored journeys are claimed.
